description: AI-enabled facial recognition system to monitor student attendance in government schools, ensuring transparency and accurate records for educational improvement.
body_lead: The attendance of students in all government and aided schools in the State will be monitored by Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled facial recognition system from the academic year 2025-26. This is expected to provide accurate daily attendance records of school children, identify absentees, and ensure transparency in the implementation of student-focused programmes. The government has developed a separate mobile application and has included all the information of students in the Students Achievement Tracking System (SATS).
